description:
## Goal

Bring octo_pi keyboard shortcut coverage to parity with upstream pi-mono coding-agent, as documented in `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md` (52 user-facing actions; 72 unique action ids across the two upstream registries `TUI_KEYBINDINGS` + `KEYBINDINGS`).

## Reference materials

- **Upstream registries**:
  - `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/keybindings.ts` (TUI primitives, 30 ids)
  - `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts` (app overlay, 41 ids)
- **Upstream doc**: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md`
- **Our current registry**: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex`
- **Our key parser**: `apps/octo_pi_tui_terminal/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal/key_parser.ex`
- **Telemetry trace** (validation tool): `mix pi --log-telemetry=/tmp/pi_trace.log` emits parsed Key events; use tmux + `tmux send-keys` for reproducible probes. Memory note: always validate terminal behavior in tmux.

## Architectural facts (load-bearing for porting)

1. **Two registries, one manager.** `KEYBINDINGS = {...TUI_KEYBINDINGS, ...app actions}` (`coding-agent/src/core/keybindings.ts:63-202`). `KeybindingsManager.matches(data, id)` is the single dispatcher used everywhere.

2. **Three input handlers** consume bindings, each owning a non-overlapping subset:
   - `Editor.handleInput` (`tui/src/components/editor.ts:534-810`) — every `tui.editor.*`, `tui.input.{newLine,submit,tab,copy}`, plus `tui.select.*` while autocomplete is open.
   - `CustomEditor.handleInput` (`coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/custom-editor.ts`) — extends `Editor`. Checks `app.clipboard.pasteImage`, `app.interrupt`, `app.exit`, then iterates `actionHandlers` for any other `app.*` action; falls through to `Editor.handleInput`.
   - **Selector components** — when a selector is mounted via `showSelector` (`interactive-mode.ts:3682-3693`), the editor is unmounted from `editorContainer` and the selector becomes the focus. The selector consumes both `tui.select.*` and selector-local `app.*` actions. **App actions like `app.suspend` or `app.model.select` do not fire while a selector is up** — by design.

3. **Single-line `Input` component reuses `tui.editor.*`** for cursor/deletion/yank inside selector search boxes (`tui/src/components/input.ts:85-200`). Each `Editor` and each `Input` owns a private `KillRing` (`tui/src/components/editor.ts:265`). **Kill ring is per-instance, never global.**

4. **Same key, different action depending on focus.** This is pervasive and the port must respect it:
   - `ctrl+d`: editor → forward-delete or exit; session-selector → delete session; tree-selector → tree-filter default
   - `ctrl+p`: editor → cycle model; session-selector → toggle path; scoped-models → toggle provider
   - `ctrl+l`: editor → model selector; tree-selector → filter labeled-only
   - `ctrl+t`: editor → toggle thinking; tree-selector → filter no-tools
   - `ctrl+a`: editor → cursor line start; tree-selector → filter all; scoped-models → enable all
   - `ctrl+u`: editor → delete to line start; tree-selector → filter user-only
   - `ctrl+o`: editor → tools.expand; tree-selector → filter cycle forward
   - `ctrl+s`: session-selector → toggle sort; scoped-models → save
   - `ctrl+c`: editor → app.clear (or copy); selector → cancel
   - `alt+up`: editor → message.dequeue; scoped-models → reorderUp

5. **`/reload` slash command** (`interactive-mode.ts:4687`) reparses `~/.pi/agent/keybindings.json` without restart; the registry-side migration map for legacy ids → namespaced ids is at `core/keybindings.ts:204-264`.

## Validation status (from prior tmux audit)

| Status | Shortcuts |
|---|---|
| ✅ Working end-to-end | `ctrl+a/e/b/f/left/right/alt+b/f/alt+left/right/ctrl+left/right`, `enter`, `shift+enter`, `ctrl+u`, `ctrl+w`, `ctrl+y`, `ctrl+z` (suspend), `/`, `escape`, `?` |
| ⚠️ Parsed + dispatched, effect not observable in default env | `ctrl+l`, `ctrl+p`, `shift+ctrl+p`, `ctrl+t`, `shift+tab`, `ctrl+o`, `alt+enter`, `alt+up`, `ctrl+g`, `ctrl+v`, `ctrl+-` (undo possibly broken) |
| ❌ Confirmed broken | `Home`/`End` keys: parser fails on `\x1b[1~`/`\x1b[4~`, returns `unknown` |
| ❌ Not implemented | All 22 actions across editor jump (2), sessions (10), tree nav (4), scoped models (6) |

## Children

T1 (parser) is the smallest standalone fix. T12 (audit) blocks on every other child so it serves as the closure validation. Each child is sized so the next agent can shape it into a sub-epic with finer subtickets if needed; ample upstream file:line references are embedded so the next agent doesn't need this conversation's context.
title: True up keyboard shortcuts to upstream pi-mono
